g.text: The same failure — one server dies mid-session — on both sides
STATEFUL · session lives in the server
· scaling out does not help Bob — his state was
only ever on the box that died
· deploys are disruptive: draining a box means
waiting out every session pinned to it
· the LB now has to remember routing decisions
· the next request just lands on App 1 or 3
· autoscaling and rolling deploys are trivial
· cost: one network hop per request, and the
store is now on the critical path
"Stateless" never means the state disappeared — it means it moved somewhere shared and durable, so any server is interchangeable.
